import h5py, numpy as np

V2  = 'well_output_v2/lifted_hydrogen_jet_traj_5000.hdf5'
REF = '/pscratch/sd/s/shreyas/COMB-FLOW-UNI/Kiran/holdout/well_output/lifted_hydrogen_jet_traj_5000.hdf5'

def compare(m, r, label):
    diff = np.abs(m.astype(np.float64) - r.astype(np.float64))
    print(f'  {label:<30s} max_abs={diff.max():.3e}  exact={np.array_equal(m,r)}')

with h5py.File(V2) as vf, h5py.File(REF) as rf:
    print('=== ROOT ATTRS ===')
    for k in sorted(set(vf.attrs) | set(rf.attrs)):
        mv = str(vf.attrs.get(k, '<MISSING>'))
        rv = str(rf.attrs.get(k, '<MISSING>'))
        tag = 'OK  ' if mv == rv else 'DIFF'
        print(f'  {tag}  {k}: v2={mv!r}  ref={rv!r}')

    print()
    print('=== FIELDS ===')
    for name in ['density', 'pressure', 'temperature',
                 'mass_fraction_h', 'mass_fraction_h2',
                 'mass_fraction_o', 'mass_fraction_o2', 'mass_fraction_oh',
                 'mass_fraction_h2o', 'mass_fraction_ho2', 'mass_fraction_h2o2']:
        compare(vf[f't0_fields/{name}'][:], rf[f't0_fields/{name}'][:], name)
    compare(vf['t1_fields/velocity'][:], rf['t1_fields/velocity'][:], 'velocity')

    print()
    print('=== DIMENSIONS ===')
    for d in ['time', 'x', 'y']:
        compare(vf[f'dimensions/{d}'][:], rf[f'dimensions/{d}'][:], d)

    print()
    print('=== BC MASKS ===')
    for bc in ['x_open', 'y_open']:
        key = f'boundary_conditions/{bc}/mask'
        compare(vf[key][:], rf[key][:], bc + '/mask')
        print(f'    dtype: v2={vf[key].dtype}  ref={rf[key].dtype}')
